quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence/production and consumption/footprint accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS revision/correction history is preserved; superseded values are not silently treated as current.
DfT 2025 RTFO and SAF fifth-provisional publications remain provisional; November 2026 final data are future and not treated as observed.
DfT vehicle registrations, vehicle stock and zero-emission vehicle counts remain activity/stock measures rather than direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grant values and product eligibility remain scheme-administration evidence rather than measured greenhouse-gas reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS country-specific factors remain calculation/reporting tools rather than direct measurements.
DESNZ local-authority estimates are subnational aggregates using nationally consistent methods and proxies; they are not individual parcel measurements.
Defra consumption-footprint statistics remain distinct from territorial and residence measures; 24 July 2026 correction status is retained.
Publication date and reference period remain separate, and future announcements are not counted as observations.
No individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
